title: Disclosure and Transparency Rules of the Mongolian Stock Exchange (revised edition), clause 3.7 ESG report
citation: Attachment to Resolution No. 47 of 4 October 2024 of the Board of Directors of the Mongolian Stock Exchange
evidence: Header of the rules: "Attachment to Resolution No.47 dated 04 October 2024 of the Board of Directors of the Mongolian Stock Exchange". The text has no commencement clause, so the issue date is used (lookup policy for acts without one). Clause 3.7: "The issuer listed under Classification I of the Exchange's registry shall submit information on the measures and activities undertaken in the areas of Environment, Social, and Governance ... by April 30th of the following year." Opened https://mse.mn/uploads/images/laws/Disclosure%20and%20Transparency%20Rules%20(unofficial%20translation).pdf on 2026-11-03 (HTTP 200, 90827 bytes).
notes: Link only: the MSE terms page could not be found, so MN-MSE-ADOPTED is permission requested. The only copy found is the English text that the MSE itself labels "unofficial translation"; the Mongolian original was not located on mse.mn. Categories II and III may report on a voluntary basis (clause 3.7). Companion guidance: the FRC ESG and Sustainability Reporting Guidance of August 2022 is voluntary (register.csv row F7).

title: Law on Climate Change (Уур амьсгалын өөрчлөлтийн тухай хууль)
citation: Law of Mongolia of 2 July 2026 (State Great Khural electronic copy 26-h-07)
evidence: The adopted text (https://old.parliament.mn/files/c619e1c1262147a385f910d25c3c9e9c/?d=1, opened 2026-11-03) is headed "2026 оны 07 сарын 02 өдөр" and has no commencement clause; art. 31.1 sets "хууль хүчин төгөлдөр болсон өдрөөс хойш 6 сарын дотор" for the regulations in art. 7.1.8 to 7.1.11. A PwC alert gives 2026-08-03 as the in-force date; that is not an official page and is not used.
notes: Climate framework act; its carbon market provisions (art. 8 and following, art. 29.1 ban on selling carbon credits without the authorised body's statement) are F3 content. One record dated 2026-07-02, the adoption date printed on the text, because no official page gives a commencement date. The text sets no in-force date; the brief gives 2026-08-03, unconfirmed. Implementing regulations under art. 7.1.8 to 7.1.11 are due within six months and are not yet enacted, so none is in scope. Languages: mn only. English looked for on old.parliament.mn and mecc.gov.mn: none found.

Related: mn-law-climate-change, which gives the carbon market a statutory basis. Languages: mn only. English looked for on mecc.gov.mn: none found (the Mondaq article that names the procedure is a law firm piece).
